Dux.name: Dux
Dux.summary: DUX is a homebrew horizontal scrolling shoot-'em-up for Dreamcast, inspired by classic shoot-'em-ups such as Gradius and R-Type. The original release was self-published by HUCAST.Net in 2009, while an updated version titled DUX 1.5 was released in 2013.

Test Drive V-Rally.name: Test Drive V-Rally
Test Drive V-Rally.summary: V-Rally 2 is a rally racing video game and the sequel to V-Rally. It was succeeded by V-Rally 3. The PlayStation version is known in Europe as V-Rally 2: Championship Edition and in North America as Need for Speed: V-Rally 2. The Dreamcast and Windows versions are known in Europe as V-Rally 2: Expert Edition and in North America the Dreamcast Version is known as Test Drive: V-Rally.
